stories.title: Who's on the CFP bubble after the committee's fourth ranking?
stories.summary: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

stories.title: Steelers bench struggling QB Rodgers, to start Rudolph
stories.summary: Pittsburgh Steelers coach Mike McCarthy has benched starting quarterback Aaron Rodgers in favor of backup Mason Rudolph.

stories.title: Indiana falls from 12-team field in 4th CFP rankings; Horns, Vols leap Bama
stories.summary: Defending champ Indiana fell six spots to No. 14, while Alabama was leaped by Texas and Tennessee and fell out of the top five in the latest CFP rankings Tuesday night.

stories.title: Geno says he doesn't even recognize UConn after loss to South Carolina
stories.summary: Huskies coach Geno Auriemma oozed with exasperation and said he was searching for answers following his team's latest loss.

stories.title: LSU asks judge to throw out 'unwarranted' lawsuit by SEC
stories.summary: LSU is asking a federal judge to dismiss the SEC's lawsuit against the Tigers, arguing that many of the plaintiffs in the case are protected by sovereign immunity as state officials and that the league doesn't have jurisdiction.
